brief.markdown:
# Vendor Risk Assessment Brief: Cloudflare

## Summary
Cloudflare is a critical edge security vendor with renewal approaching. Pulse found three verified public signals from Cloudflare-owned pages in its curated fallback review: compliance resources, commercial data-localization scope, and a resolved Log Explorer incident.

## Key Verified Signals
- Trust/security: Cloudflare lists ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and SOC 2 Type II among its compliance resources.
- Pricing/terms: Data Localization Suite is identified as an Enterprise-only paid add-on.
- Status: Cloudflare reported that affected customers could see dashboard and API log delays during a resolved Log Explorer incident.

## Evidence Table
| Signal | Support | Source | Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Compliance resources | verified | https://www.cloudflare.com/trust-hub/ | Request current in-scope evidence for renewal. |
| Data localization add-on | verified | https://developers.cloudflare.com/data-localization/ | Confirm regulated-data scope and commercial impact. |
| Log Explorer incident | verified | https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/ | Check operational impact on monitoring workflows. |

## Risk Interpretation
These signals do not establish a security breach or control failure. They create a review checkpoint: SecurePay should confirm required compliance artifacts, determine whether data localization changes commercial scope, and assess whether the resolved log-visibility incident affected its monitoring obligations.

## Recommended Action
Schedule a renewal diligence review with Security and Procurement. Request the applicable compliance package and confirm Data Localization Suite requirements before signature.

## Suggested Owner
Security, with Procurement support.

## Review Status
Needs review before renewal. In live-with-fallback mode, Bright Data live trace telemetry is recorded separately and this brief remains based on verified cached fallback excerpts.
